freshness_method: Guarded promotion must check exact target IDs against all canonical Urdu A1-B1 and live B2 sequences 1-6 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: account; an organized record or place where money is held or tracked
survival or continued ability to meet essential needs
flat or apartment used as a housing unit
brand; a named commercial identity associated with a product
advertising or promotion intended to influence attention or demand
inheritance; property or resources passed from one generation to another
equality; comparable treatment, opportunity, or standing
guarantor; a person or party accepting responsibility if another fails to meet an obligation

generation_guardrails: B2 passage text remains in the 350-550 whitespace-token production band.
P1-P5 introduce exactly two new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all ten.
Difficulty comes from trade-offs, incentives, opportunity cost, distribution, assumptions, and counterarguments rather than vocabulary density.
All monetary examples are fictional and illustrative; no passage gives individualized financial or investment advice.
Housing, inheritance, consumer, and credit scenarios avoid presenting one policy choice as universally optimal.
Generation/integrity state remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
freshness_scope: Exact target IDs checked against all canonical Urdu A1-B1 and B2 sequences 1-6 immediately before Unit 2 append.
